alt: AI-generated fictional fashion portrait of four adult women grouped on cushioned seating above a river-view cityscape. A braided woman in an ivory mini leans her head toward a blonde woman in a copper top and blue skort. A woman in a wine-red pearl-trimmed mini clasps their hands, while a fourth in slate blue rests a hand on her shoulder. Pale and blue star-marked stockings, copper and wine-red boots, and one rainbow RAZE boot are visible. Distant fire, smoke and a mushroom-shaped cloud are imaginary scenery, not a real event.
